summary: End-to-end testing of the new Robotics Kit Shop feature (public catalog, guest checkout, Cashfree payment init, vendor PO split via webhook, admin panel). All 17 backend pytest cases pass, and frontend flow (shop → cart drawer → checkout form → /api/shop/orders + /api/shop/initiate-payment → Cashfree hosted checkout redirect) works as expected. Admin /admin/shop renders all three tabs with real data, 139 products are loaded with edit buttons, and webhook-triggered PO split produces one PO per vendor.

issues: First load shows 140 cards (one extra over the expected ~139). Acceptable per spec ('~139'), but may indicate the vendor catalog now returns 140 rows — confirm with PM.

When redirected to Cashfree the merchant 'Broken Link!' page appears because the preview domain camp-lead-capture.preview.emergentagent.com is not whitelisted in the Cashfree merchant dashboard. This is a Cashfree merchant config issue, NOT a code bug — the order + payment_session_id are correctly created. Production domain (oll.co) is already approved.

action_items: Optional: ensure the preview domain is added to Cashfree merchant whitelist if you want full end-to-end checkout in preview (not required for production).
Optional: confirm whether 139 vs 140 product count delta is acceptable; the vendor public API now returns 140 items.
critical_code_review_comments: shop.py is ~730 lines — getting close to the 700-line guideline; consider splitting into sub-modules (products / orders / webhook / admin) if it grows further.

_finalize_paid_order schedules _send_order_confirmation_email via asyncio.create_task without exception logging at task level — failures inside email task are silent except for the warn log inside the function (currently fine).
_submit_vendor_pos: every PO attempt makes a fresh httpx.AsyncClient — for multi-vendor carts, opening a single client and looping would be slightly more efficient (low priority).
Public webhook endpoint has no signature verification (Cashfree x-webhook-signature). For production-grade hardening, validate the webhook signature before marking orders paid.
verify endpoint on a pending order falls back to PGFetchOrder; if Cashfree returns 'ACTIVE' it's surfaced as-is which is fine, but tests should expect both 'pending' and 'ACTIVE'.
seed_data_creation: Test buyer orders created via tests: 4 shop_orders + 1 simulated PAID order + 1 shop_purchase_orders row (vendor We Tech Shiksha Labs Pvt Ltd). Override on first product set to mrp=3499 selling_price=2999, then reverted to show_on_shop=true. shop_product_overrides collection has 1 doc.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_shop.py — pytest -k test_shop runs the whole suite in ~8s. The webhook simulation directly POSTs to /api/shop/webhook with {data:{order:{order_id,order_status:'PAID'}}} after creating order + initiate-payment, and asserts admin/shop/purchase-orders contains exactly one PO per vendor (single-vendor catalog right now). For frontend, valid Cashfree redirect lands on the Cashfree-hosted 'Broken Link' page in preview — that means the payment session was created successfully; only the merchant whitelist for that domain is missing. Vendor API currently returns 140 products (off-by-one vs spec 139).
rca of the issue: No issues found. Feature works as designed.
